thread:
maria (PM): quick sync — NimbusHealth pushed back their pilot timeline to mid-june and they want tenant-level audit logs + SSO before they go live. they’re saying it's a hard requirement for pilot.

alex (Eng): ouch. which pieces exactly? full SAML SSO + per-tenant audit stream?

maria (PM): yep SAML + audit export (syslog/S3) + ability to rotate tenant keys. they implied NDA audit next month so timeline is tight.

sam (SRE): SAML is doable with the oauth shim we started, but tenant-audit streaming touches infra we haven't hardened for multi-tenant export. risk: durability + perf under load.

priya (Design): UX implication: login flow needs tenant scoping + admin console for audit exports. we can stub a simple admin panel for MVP but it won’t have filtering/retention UI.

alex (Eng): options: A) prioritize SSO + basic audit export for MVP (cut: advanced filtering, retention UI, per-token insights) B) push audit export to v1 and deliver SSO + temporary CSV export for MVP C) ask Nimbus to accept longer pilot.

maria (PM): Nimbus says pilot must include audit export (machine-consumable) — CSV might be acceptable if we surface an automated export.

jamie (VP Product): we need criteria-based decision. propose acceptance criteria for MVP if we go the carve-in route: 1) SAML SSO healthy in canary 2) automated audit export to S3/syslog with <5min delivery for 99% of events 3) per-tenant key rotation works end-to-end 4) no P0 infra regressions in canary.

alex (Eng): realistic? 2) is the heavy one. we haven't tested sustained audit write throughput. work estimate: ~3 sprint-days to wire export + 2 for testing + unknown for scale fixes.

sam (SRE): add gating: full e2e test must run in canary for 48h with traffic replay. otherwise we cut audit to v1.

maria (PM): tradeoff: if we carve audit into v1, Nimbus may delay pilot. but Nimbus is small pilot customer — we could accept CSV exports for pilot. team: what's the delta to support CSV export automated?

alex (Eng): CSV export path is ~1 sprint-day to generate and drop to S3 on schedule. less infra risk.

priya (Design): we can ship a minimal admin UI to trigger exports and show last-run status. 2 UI days.

jamie (VP Product): suggestion: pursue hybrid plan — ship SAML + CSV automated export in MVP with clear docs and commit to audit streaming for v1 with target: 6 weeks post-pilot. set rollout policy: canary w/ traffic replay + SRE 48h watch.

maria (PM): sounds good. action items: Alex to scope & start SAML + CSV export, Sam to define canary replay test + success metrics, Priya to mock admin UI, I'll draft customer-facing commitments.

alex (Eng): started a tiny RFC in #eng-runtime with high-level plan. putting WIP PR up for SAML config.

sam (SRE): will post the replay checklist and the thresholds: delivery latency <5m for 99th, zero data loss tolerance for pilot.

priya (Design): will drop a Figma with admin panel comps by EOD tomorrow.

maria (PM): timeline rebaseline: aim for MVP ship to Nimbus pilot in 3 weeks if no major blockers. if canary shows issues we'll move pilot by 2 weeks. documenting in roadmap.

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary/saml-shim v0.3 -> prod-canary at 1749804300

alex (Eng): :thumbsup: tracking PRs: #512 (saml config), #518 (csv-export). will update estimates today.

jamie (VP Product): calling this decision: MVP = SAML + automated CSV audit export; v1 = full audit streaming + admin retention controls. note: signal-level docs so support can set expectations.

maria (PM): agreed. I'll post the customer commit and update the roadmap doc. follow-ups assigned in the RFC. any objections?

alex (Eng): none from eng.

sam (SRE): none.

priya (Design): none.

maria (PM): cool — closing thread, will attach the acceptance criteria and timeline to the milestone ticket. :rocket:
